arcs.title: The Kuru house
arcs.summary: A vow, an inheritance, and two branches of one family.

arcs.title: Court & exile
arcs.summary: A throne is won, lost, and argued for again.

arcs.title: Kurukṣetra
arcs.summary: From the failed peace mission through the commanders of the war.

arcs.title: After the battle
arcs.summary: Grief, government, and what victory costs.

arcs.title: The last journeys
arcs.summary: The Yādavas fall and the Pāṇḍavas leave their kingdom.

books.name: Ādi
books.title: Beginnings
books.summary: Bhīṣma’s vow reshapes the succession. The Pāṇḍavas and Kauravas grow up in the same royal house, and the competition for power begins.

books.name: Sabhā
books.title: The assembly hall
books.summary: Yudhiṣṭhira’s royal consecration is followed by the dice match, Draupadī’s challenge in the hall, and a sentence of exile.

books.name: Āraṇyaka
books.title: The forest years
books.summary: The Pāṇḍavas travel in exile, learn from visiting sages, and hear stories such as that of Nala and Damayantī.

books.name: Virāṭa
books.title: A year in hiding
books.summary: The exiles enter Virāṭa’s service under assumed names. A cattle raid forces Arjuna back into action.

books.name: Udyoga
books.title: Before the armies march
books.summary: Envoys attempt a settlement while the two sides seek allies. Kṛṣṇa’s peace mission comes before the armies face one another.

books.name: Bhīṣma
books.title: The war opens
books.summary: The armies assemble at Kurukṣetra. Arjuna’s hesitation frames the Bhagavad Gītā, and Bhīṣma eventually falls under a rain of arrows.

books.name: Droṇa
books.title: A vow before sunset
books.summary: Droṇa takes command. After Abhimanyu falls, Arjuna vows to kill Jayadratha before sunset on the following day.

books.name: Karṇa
books.title: The duel
books.summary: Karṇa leads the Kaurava forces. His rivalry with Arjuna culminates in the duel in which his chariot wheel sinks.

books.name: Śalya
books.title: The last day
books.summary: Śalya commands the remaining Kaurava army. The fighting closes with the mace duel between Bhīma and Duryodhana.

books.name: Sauptika
books.title: The night raid
books.summary: Aśvatthāman and his companions attack the sleeping camp. The fighting continues after the main battle has ended.

books.name: Strī
books.title: The bereaved
books.summary: Gāndhārī and the women of the royal families see the battlefield and mourn the dead. The book follows the people who must live with the war’s outcome.

books.name: Śānti
books.title: How should a king rule?
books.summary: Yudhiṣṭhira struggles with the cost of victory. Bhīṣma teaches him about government, emergencies, and liberation.

books.name: Anuśāsana
books.title: Bhīṣma’s final teachings
books.summary: Bhīṣma continues his teaching, including discussions of gifts and duties. At the end of the book he dies.

books.name: Āśvamedhika
books.title: Rebuilding the kingdom
books.summary: Yudhiṣṭhira performs the horse sacrifice. Arjuna follows the released horse and encounters challenges from other rulers.

books.name: Āśramavāsika
books.title: The elders leave court
books.summary: Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Gāndhārī, and Kuntī withdraw to the forest. News of their deaths reaches Yudhiṣṭhira.

books.name: Mausala
books.title: The end of the Yādavas
books.summary: Conflict destroys the Yādavas. Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma depart, and the narrative recounts the loss of Dvārakā.

books.name: Mahāprasthānika
books.title: The northern journey
books.summary: The Pāṇḍavas and Draupadī lay down their rule and travel north. Yudhiṣṭhira continues with a dog as his companion.

books.name: Svargārohaṇa
books.title: Yudhiṣṭhira’s final test
books.summary: Yudhiṣṭhira encounters an unexpected heaven and hell. The tale closes by testing where his loyalties lie.

episodes.title: The vow that changes the throne
episodes.summary: Bhīṣma renounces his claim and promises to remain unmarried so Śāntanu can marry Satyavatī. The promise changes who can inherit.

episodes.title: The house of lac
episodes.summary: The brothers face an engineered fire at Vāraṇāvata. Vidura’s warning helps them escape through a tunnel.

episodes.title: Draupadī’s svayaṃvara
episodes.summary: The Pāṇḍavas reach Pañcāla in disguise. Arjuna completes the trial at Draupadī’s svayaṃvara.

episodes.title: A new capital
episodes.summary: The Pāṇḍavas receive a share of the kingdom and establish Indraprastha. Their new court changes the rivalry between the families.

episodes.title: The dice match
episodes.summary: Śakuni plays on Duryodhana’s behalf. After Yudhiṣṭhira loses, Draupadī asks whether he had the authority to stake her.

episodes.title: Into the forest
episodes.summary: The brothers and Draupadī leave the court. The forest books follow their travels and the debates and stories told along the way.

episodes.title: A story within the exile
episodes.summary: Bṛhadaśva tells the exiled Yudhiṣṭhira about Nala and Damayantī. Their separation and reunion offer another way to understand the aftermath of a dice game.

episodes.title: The year in disguise
episodes.summary: The brothers and Draupadī live under assumed identities at Virāṭa’s court. A raid on the cattle puts their disguises at risk.

episodes.title: Kṛṣṇa’s peace mission
episodes.summary: Kṛṣṇa travels to the Kuru court to seek a settlement. The mission ends without an agreement and preparations for battle continue.

episodes.title: Vyāsa reads the omens
episodes.summary: Vyāsa describes disturbing signs to Dhṛtarāṣṭra. One verse mentions Arundhatī and Vasiṣṭha, and nearby passages mention planets and the luminaries.

episodes.title: Arjuna stops the chariot
episodes.summary: Arjuna asks Kṛṣṇa to stop between the armies. Seeing family, teachers, and friends on both sides, he questions whether to fight.

episodes.title: Bhīṣma falls
episodes.summary: Arjuna advances with Śikhaṇḍin. Bhīṣma is brought down and remains on a bed of arrows.

episodes.title: Droṇa takes command
episodes.summary: Duryodhana asks Karṇa who can lead the army after Bhīṣma falls. Karṇa proposes Droṇa.

episodes.title: Abhimanyu enters the formation
episodes.summary: Abhimanyu enters Droṇa’s formation. He is separated from help and killed, leading to Arjuna’s vow.

episodes.title: The vow and the darkening sky
episodes.summary: Arjuna must reach Jayadratha before sunset. Ganguli’s rendering describes darkness produced through yoga, a scene sometimes read as an eclipse.

episodes.title: Droṇa lays down his weapons
episodes.summary: The report of Aśvatthāman’s death breaks Droṇa’s resolve. Dhṛṣṭadyumna attacks after he casts down his weapons.

episodes.title: Karṇa leads the surviving army
episodes.summary: After Droṇa’s death, Karṇa lines up Duryodhana’s army at dawn.

episodes.title: Arjuna and Karṇa
episodes.summary: Karṇa’s chariot wheel sinks during the duel. The scene turns on a dispute over the rules of battle.

episodes.title: The final duel
episodes.summary: Bhīma and Duryodhana fight with maces. The closing blow prompts arguments about how the duel was won.

episodes.title: The sleeping camp
episodes.summary: Aśvatthāman enters the enemy camp at night. The attack targets survivors of the battle.

episodes.title: Gāndhārī on the battlefield
episodes.summary: Gāndhārī and the other bereaved women walk among the fallen. This is the aftermath as seen by families.

episodes.title: Lessons in kingship
episodes.summary: While Bhīṣma lies wounded, Yudhiṣṭhira seeks guidance on ruling and on the duties that come with power.

episodes.title: Bhīṣma’s death
episodes.summary: After teaching Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhīṣma chooses the time of his death. The interval and seasonal wording enter Oak’s dating argument.

episodes.title: The horse sacrifice
episodes.summary: The horse’s journey links the restored court to other rulers. Arjuna travels with it and faces challenges along the way.

episodes.title: The elders withdraw
episodes.summary: Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Gāndhārī, and Kuntī leave the court for forest life. Yudhiṣṭhira later learns how they died.

episodes.title: The end of Dvārakā
episodes.summary: The book follows the destruction of the Yādavas and the loss of Dvārakā. Literary accounts and the dating of marine finds are distinct questions.

episodes.title: The last journey
episodes.summary: The Pāṇḍavas leave the throne and go north. Yudhiṣṭhira refuses to abandon the dog that follows him.

episodes.title: The final test
episodes.summary: Yudhiṣṭhira is confronted with an unexpected picture of heaven and hell. The book closes by revealing the purpose of that test.
